* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Interrupt: Outflank, Endor, C
|strategy=By [mailto:jralrea@ilstu.edu Joe Alread]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/outflank.html</ref>

High destiny draws that recycle back into your deck are always a good thing, and [[Outflank]] gives you exactly that, when it comes to Biker Scouts. The first use of this interrupt will be extremely hard to pull off, however to pull the second use off, all you need is to do is get a Biker Scout out on the table and your ready to roll. Your Biker Scout gets power +1, and you get a six destiny back in your deck. Sounds like a good idea to me! All you need to do is remember where that 6 is!
